title: The Complete Angler 1653
author: Izaak Walton
description: "The Complete Angler 1653" by Izaak Walton is a book published in 1653.
longDescription: Written in the aftermath of the English Civil War, it celebrates the art and spirit of fishing through prose and verse.

authorInfo.bio: Izaak Walton (1593–1683) wrote The Complete Angler 1653. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
